start: First own workout just finished; a Wear OS watch is connected without the MettleUp app

user_sees: Card 'MettleUp works on your watch too'
'See your rest timer and next set on your wrist.'
'Install on watch' and 'Not now'
must_not: The card with no watch connected
The card after only demo workouts

user_sees: 'Opening on your watch…'
Then 'Check your watch: its Play Store is open on MettleUp. Tap Install there.'
must_not: A spinner that never ends
A crash when Play services are missing

steps.action: Come back to the Workout tab later
user_sees: The card is gone for good
must_not: The card coming back

start: First time the member starts a workout, watch without the app

user_sees: Slim card 'Install MettleUp on your watch'
'See your rest timer, next set and heart rate on your wrist while you train.'
must_not: The card on a resumed or past workout
The card a second time

user_sees: 'Installed' or 'Install on watch'
must_not: The row shown with no watch connected

steps.action: Tap it when it says 'Install on watch'
user_sees: The same 'Check your watch...' line
must_not: The row still saying 'Install on watch' after the app is on the watch

start: Install on watch tapped, but things go wrong

steps.action: Tap with the watch out of range
user_sees: 'Your watch is not connected. Open Play Store on your watch and search MettleUp.'
must_not: A success line

steps.action: Tap when Wear OS refuses or times out (20 s)
user_sees: 'Open Play Store on your watch and search MettleUp.'
must_not: A crash
The card closed for good as if it worked

start: Card shown after the first workout

user_sees: The card goes and never comes back
must_not: The card back on the next visit

steps.action: Install the app on the watch by other means, open Settings
user_sees: 'Your watch' row says 'Installed'
Install tap says 'MettleUp is already on your watch. When you start a workout, it opens on your watch too.'
must_not: The install card still offered

start: Member reads the start card's promise of heart rate on the wrist

steps.action: Install and train with the watch
user_sees: Heart rate shown only on the phone and watch
must_not: Heart rate sent to MettleUp or the gym
The watch app offered as paid to a gym member whose plan is active
